title: Game freezes on startup — ROM bank missing
backstory: The cabinet boots to a blank or frozen screen. The game never reaches attract mode.
visible_effect: Program ROM address space corrupted — the CPU fetches garbage opcodes. MAME will misexecute or hang within a few frames.
diagnosis_hint: Blank screen at boot almost always means the CPU can't fetch valid code. Check the ROM chip-select line from the address decoder (74155A output pin 4). A stuck-low CS will float the data bus. Reseat the address decoder IC first; if the fault persists, replace it.
